# Spokane Tech Jobs

> A directory and job board for the tech ecosystem of Spokane, Eastern
> Washington and North Idaho: the companies, the roles they have open, and the
> people building here, on one map. Every row is sourced from public records; a fact nobody published is
> null rather than guessed.

The data is open, CC BY 4.0. Use it, quote it, reuse it — attribution to
Spokane Tech Jobs is all that is asked.

Employers: adding a company and posting jobs are both free, and listings run
90 days with a one-click refresh. See https://spokanetechjobs.com/employers/

## Companies

- [116 & West](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/116-and-west.html): Full-service creative and advertising agency with offices in Boise and Spokane
- [14Four](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/14four.html): Digital studio building games, AR experiences, 3D animation, websites and campaign work for national brands
- [4 Degrees Real Estate](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/4-degrees-real-estate.html): Full-service real estate company — realty, property management and investment — started by brothers Jordan and Joel Tampien
- [ALK Source Materials](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/alk-source-materials.html): ALK-Abello's source-materials laboratory, supplying pollens, mites, insect venoms and other allergen materials used in allergy immunotherapy and diagnostics
- [ATC Manufacturing](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/atc-manufacturing.html): Thermoplastic composite parts for aerospace and defense
- [Absco Solutions](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/absco-solutions.html): Designs, installs and services fire, life-safety and security systems for facilities; this is its Spokane office
- [Accra-Fab](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/accra-fab.html): Contract manufacturer doing precision sheet metal fabrication, machining, welding, finishing and assembly for aerospace, communications, medical and energy customers
- [Advanced Input Systems](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/advanced-input-systems.html): Human-machine interface hardware: keyboards, embedded computers and custom-designed input technologies
- [Advantage Advertising](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/advantage-advertising.html): Full-service advertising agency doing video, digital and social marketing, web design and public relations
- [Aerocet](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/aerocet.html): Builds aircraft floats, including the 1500 Amphib, 2200 and 3400 Amphib models, in Priest River
- [Allele Diagnostics](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/allele-diagnostics.html): Clinical genetics laboratory providing microarray, karyotyping and FISH testing for neonatal, pediatric and prenatal patients
- [Alphy](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/alphy.html): Makes HarmCheck, AI communication-compliance software that flags harmful or non-compliant messages before they are sent

- [Atomic](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/atomic.html): Fintech whose APIs connect apps to people's payroll accounts, for direct deposit switching and income verification; one of its co-founders is based in Spokane

- [Berg Companies](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/berg-companies.html): Manufacturer of hard- and soft-wall shelter systems, fuel and water systems and power management, largely for military use
- [BioTracking](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/biotracking.html): Developed and markets BioPRYN, an early blood-based pregnancy test for cattle and other ruminants, based on research at the University of Idaho
- [Blaze Barrier](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/blaze-barrier.html): Portable, flame-activated wildfire suppression modules — a fire line in a box — that deploy on contact with flames to stop a fire's advance
- [Buck Knives](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/buck-knives.html): Knife maker since 1902, headquartered and manufacturing in Post Falls since 2005; every knife carries its Forever Warranty

- [CarbonQuest](https://spokanetechjobs.com/companies/carbonquest.html): Modular distributed carbon capture systems that capture, separate and liquefy CO2 from buildings, biogas facilities and industrial sites
